title: Six tons of missing fissionable material at Chernobyl

tellings.quote: >> Six tons of fisionable material that was at the plant, not in the reactors. Was it was at the plant was missing.

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says that at Chernobyl, the Soviet nuclear plant where a reactor exploded in 1986, six tons of fissionable material went missing: material that was kept at the plant, not inside the reactors. Buchanan tells Michels this as something he dealt with himself, and it would mean that dangerous nuclear material vanished amid the disaster.
